validity.recommendation: Keep Proposed. Treat the 1,000 km length as an indicative figure for one studied route.
validity.researcher_notes: The sources opened (Neftegaz 2023, Kursiv 2024, Interfax 2025) show real government-level talks on a Russia to Kazakhstan to China line. No construction or design contract is reported. Figures differ by source: 40 bcm/y for the Kazakh gasification part in 2023 and 45 bcm/y in 2025. The Russian planning decree lists a 10 bcm/y Kazakhstan export line, which is only the domestic supply branch.

verifications.note: An Interfax report of 9 July 2025 says the sides discuss gas pipeline infrastructure for 45 billion cubic meters a year, 10 billion for northeast Kazakhstan and 35 billion for China. This matches the 45 bcm/y on the sheet. A June 2023 Neftegaz report quotes the Kazakh energy minister with 40 bcm/y for the gasification project only. The page describes this project by its content and not by the formal name Russia-Kazakhstan-China Gas Pipeline; the match was confirmed by hand.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The newest dated citation is Interfax on 9 July 2025. Astana backs the idea and talks go on. A related Interfax item of 15 April 2025 says China finds the route too expensive. No construction start is reported, so Proposed stands.

cross_row_leads.facts: Interfax links an April 2025 report that China finds the Kazakhstan route too expensive and a December 2024 report that the process was launched. Worth a later search for a newer status.

wiki_citations_read.note: Cost 1.9 to 2 trillion tenge for the gasification project, 40 bcm/y. Staged on SegmentCost.
Same minister statement as the other Neftegaz article of June 2023, cost 1.9 to 2 trillion tenge. Same origin, so not counted as a second source. Cost record cites the first article.
Kazakh ambassador, May 2024: road map signed, 35 bcm/y to China. Supports Proposed.
45 bcm/y project, 10 for Kazakhstan and 35 for China. Supports Capacity and Status.
About 1,000 km for the Barnaul to Ust-Kamenogorsk route option. Staged on Length at low.
Minister statement of April 2023 that the route was agreed and could extend to China. Gives distances only in general terms. No value for a sheet cell.
Bruce Pannier article of 24 May 2024. Repeats the 35 bcm/y to China from the Kazakh ambassador. No length, cost or capacity for the whole project.

Russian federal planning decree list. Item 386 is a Kazakhstan export pipeline from the Tyumen region with a design volume of 10 bcm/y. That is the Russian supply branch for northern Kazakhstan, not the 45 bcm/y project, so it is not a ref for any sheet cell.

summary: "Proposed confirmed (caveat). 4 units reffed via wiki citations; cost, capacity and length come with caveats; 8 citations read."
